verdict.rationale: Supabase documents that every project is a full Postgres relational database, which by its nature supports relational SQL, and a community user confirms the dashboard handles FK constraints. The pack has no first-party documentation or examples of joins, constraints, or transaction semantics, so the depth of support is inferred rather than shown. Missing for 10: explicit docs or examples of joins (SQL or API embedding), constraint definition, transaction/atomicity support, and hands-on corroboration of transactional queries.

support.subject: As a developer, I can express relational queries with joins, constraints, and transactions

citations.quote: Every project is a full Postgres database, the world's most trusted relational database.
handles nullable fields, FK constraints, JSON defaults
